constraint: Do not use tropical Sun sign as a personality main effect.
evidence_summary: N=173,709 Big Five results were null with B10<.001; the historical N=2,324 positives are strongly exposed to prior-knowledge/self-selection confounding.
prospective_exception: none unless independently preregistered as a new hypothesis

constraint: Do not score Sun-sign love compatibility or same-sign matching.
evidence_summary: About 9.5m adjusted England/Wales marriages and 66,063 Swedish marriages/46,326 divorce-risk observations show no consistent practical effect.
prospective_exception: full-chart synastry would be a different, separately frozen hypothesis

constraint: Do not assume human whole-chart readings or chart-to-profile matching exceed chance.
evidence_summary: Carlson Part 2 was 0.34 correct versus 1/3; Indiana astrologers ranged 0–3/23; synthesis ES=.051, p=.66.
prospective_exception: a mechanically frozen model may be tested, but starts at zero evidential weight

constraint: Do not treat whole-chart similarity of near-time births as a broad personality/life similarity score.
evidence_summary: NCDS N=2,101 mean serial r=-.003 and Roberts–Greengrass reanalysis r=-.001.
prospective_exception: narrow preregistered feature-by-outcome interactions remain testable

constraint: Do not assign default hard/soft, aspect/no-aspect, 108th-harmonic, or continuous-separation personality weights.
evidence_summary: Four aspect studies in N=911 were negative; continuous scan produced 3/32 nominal p<.05, family probability .21.
prospective_exception: tightness/angularity may appear only as preregistered secondary moderators

constraint: Measure/control astrology knowledge, belief and sign-label exposure; never interpret stereotype-driven behavior as celestial prediction.
evidence_summary: Randomized sign labels changed HR judgments (hireability d=-.29) while signs did not predict actual personality/performance.
scope: all self-report, rater and occupational outcomes

constraint: Predeclare the feature universe and family-wise error/FDR or nested holdout; isolated nominal p-values are not candidates.
evidence_summary: Broad scans routinely yield isolated p<.05 findings; 3/32 in Startup and 1/9 highlighted time-twin regressions are compatible with search.

constraint: Count cohorts, not papers or feature rows; reanalyses and republications do not increase independent replication count.
evidence_summary: Mars-effect, Roberts–Greengrass and Indiana chains reuse the same participants under multiple publications/analyses.

constraint: Match feature sensitivity to verified birth-time precision and exclude/interval-code charts that cannot support the feature.
evidence_summary: Strong studies either rejected inadequate times, verified to ≤10 min, or exploited hospital-timed near births.
scope: houses, angles, sectors, fast Moon/aspects, rectification
prospective_exception: date-only features may use date-only records

constraint: A human-reader result cannot become an algorithmic feature unless the rule is deterministic or inter-rater reliability is adequate.
evidence_summary: Indiana mean pair agreement 1.4/23; current-illness κ=-.111; meta-summary agreement=.101.
prospective_exception: mechanical rule extraction with blinded audit

constraint: Generate controls that preserve calendar, latitude, longitude, hospital/time-of-day, cohort and astronomical prevalence.
evidence_summary: Census imputation created a 22,100-pair artifact; Mars-effect interpretation changes with sample/control construction.

constraint: Do not use astrology for diagnosis, violence prediction, mortality/fatality, hiring or other high-stakes person-level decisions.
evidence_summary: Claims are unreplicated/abstract-only or reliability-limited, while sign labels demonstrably cause discrimination.
scope: clinical, criminal, employment and mortality decisions
prospective_exception: aggregate methodological research with ethics review only

constraint: Do not count synthetic astrology exercises as empirical feature validation.
evidence_summary: The 2026 arXiv paper uses a humorous synthetic generator and supplies no real birth/outcome data.

constraint: Do not encode a feature from a publisher abstract when the operational definition, controls and multiplicity cannot be audited.
evidence_summary: Several recent claims are interesting but only abstracts were publicly accessible.
prospective_exception: promote only after original full text and reproducibility audit

constraint: All literature-derived features are development hypotheses; none counts as untouched validation for this project.
evidence_summary: The corpus informed feature selection and therefore cannot validate the selected model.
prospective_exception: held-out prospective replication collected after freezing
